motd: Season 1 is in preparation. Pack 0.12.0: the Board Orders (14 manufactured products, one roadmap chapter per phase), 12 Department chapters and a quest book laid out again.

news.title: Pack 0.12.0: Board Orders and the Departments
news.text: Every phase now orders manufactured products from the crews: fourteen items built across three to five mods (the Kinetic Assembly and the Provisions Crate in phase 1, the Steel Manifold, Capacitor Bank and Steam Regulator in phase 2, up to the Fusion Injector, Cryo Core and Singularity Housing in phase 5), each a quota line with its own roadmap chapter, a certification bonus on the first unit and the Master Fabricator title for whoever delivers them all. Twelve Department chapters cover every pillar of the pack with objectives and a diploma, and the whole quest book was laid out again: no more crossing lines. Client sync adds 31 small textures.

news.title: Pack 0.11.0: 69 new mods
news.text: Silent Gear tools and armour built from parts, the Productive Metalworks foundry (phase 2), Create addons (Crafts & Additions, Enchantment Industry, Slice & Dice, Connected, Copycats+, Deco, Bells & Whistles, Jetpack), AE2 addons (Extended AE, MEGA Cells, wireless terminals, ME Requester, import and export cards, Create Stock Bridge), Mekanism Additions and More Mekanism Processing, Immersive Petroleum, Iron Furnaces, Ender Storage, Dark Utilities, Lootr (every structure chest is yours to open once), FTB Ultimine (16 blocks, a real tool), the whole YUNG's and Macaw's suites, Chisel, FramedBlocks, Handcrafted, Crystalix, elevators, cosmetic armour, Polymorph, Crafting Tweaks, TrashSlot, Inventory Essentials and Ok Zoomer. Every new machine is placed in its phase, prices cover the new metals and fuels, 11 new quests explain the additions, and /spawn takes you back to HQ (15 minute cooldown). Client RAM: 6 GB recommended, the 8 GB preset still boots.

news.title: Pack 0.10.0: the HQ site, revision 2
news.text: The headquarters is a full industrial site now: the delivery hall with its copper roof and clock tower, a boiler house with two chimneys, a glass-vaulted workshop, the water tower and the rail yard, the plaza with the spawn podium and the banner masts, and a real amphitheatre east of it: four gates, three tiers, a copper canopy, corner towers, hazards on the floor and traps that arm during arena events (pitfalls, fire vents, arrow slits).

news.title: Pack 0.9.0: badges and the HQ
news.text: Ranks, titles, staff roles and charters now show as pixel badges before player names in chat and in the tab list (the active title replaces the rank badge). The player list is lighter: two header lines and two footer lines. Staff can raise the industrial headquarters with the delivery station, the shop counter, the charter desk, the plaza waystone and the event arena in one command.

news.title: Pack 0.8.0: ranks, daily contracts, onboarding
news.text: Progression ranks promote you automatically as you deliver (Operator, Engineer, Director, Shareholder) with a public leaderboard, three daily contracts pay a premium on the first units delivered, newcomers get a starter kit and can name a recruiter, /rules and the Rulebook are in game, and the calendar reminds everyone of the Wednesday contract and the weekend events.

news.title: Pack 0.7.0: quests, shop, events and prices
news.text: 129 quests in 9 chapters, a 24-entry Consortium shop (chunk loaders, claims, home slots, licences, Gap Contract, season fund, event tickets, cosmetics), a random events engine (Ore Rush, Power Surge, Market Crash, Supply Drop, Bounty, Invasion, Blood Moon, Double Quota Hour, the Friday Zone) and the complete 75-family price table. Launcher 0.3.1 shows your head next to your name.

news.title: Pack 0.6.0: new world generation, shaders and cosmetics
news.text: Terralith, Tectonic, Amplified Nether, Nullscape and four structure mods reshape the Season 1 world (fresh world). Iris shader support with Complementary Reimagined and MakeUp Ultra Fast, plus six cosmetic mods, are optional client entries you can toggle in the launcher (launcher 0.3.0). Staff tools were added on the server side only.

news.title: Full modpack published
news.text: Create, Mekanism, Applied Energistics 2, Immersive Engineering, Powah, Ad Astra, Apotheosis, the FTB suite, KubeJS and the performance mods are in. First launch downloads about 400 MB of mods.

news.title: Launcher milestone 1
news.text: The launcher can now install the game and sync the pack.
